  SELECT
    c.seq_contrato,
    o.nom_orgao,
    c.num_contrato,
    c.dat_assinatura,
    cc.dsc_nome_credor,
    c.vlr_contrato
  FROM contrato_contratos c
  JOIN orgao_orgao o
    ON c.cod_orgao = o.cod_orgao
   AND c.ano_referencia = o.ano_referencia
  LEFT JOIN contrato_contContrato cc
    ON c.seq_contrato = cc.seq_contrato
   AND c.ano_referencia = cc.ano_referencia
  WHERE c.ano_referencia = 2025
    AND o.tipo_orgao ILIKE '%AUTARQ%'
    AND o.nom_orgao ILIKE '%SAAE%'
    AND c.vlr_contrato > 0
), dedup AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.seq_contrato ORDER BY b.dsc_nome_credor) AS rn
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  nom_orgao,
  num_contrato,
  dat_assinatura,
  dsc_nome_credor,
  vlr_contrato
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY vlr_contrato DESC
LIMIT 10;
